message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build
permissions:
  contents: read
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v4
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-
      - name: Build and Test
        run: make
",
  "rationale": "The repository is a Go project with go.mod/go.sum, and the workflow repeatedly fetches dependencies on every run via `make` (which runs generate/check/test/build). The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern and its measured Go-module cache experiment support adding a dependency cache keyed on the lockfiles, preserving the existing build/test steps and coverage. This is a minimal, non-privileged change with no new network access, secrets, or deployment operations.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
